notes.title: Exclusive playtest
notes.content:
🍻 Welcome to the Beer Factory Playtest - Your Brewing Adventure Begins! 🍻

[b]Hey there, Craft Beer Enthusiasts and Master Brewers![/b]
We're excited to invite you to the exclusive playtest of Beer Factory! This is a unique opportunity to get a first-hand look at our brewing universe before the full game's release on January 10th.

[b]What to Expect in the Playtest 🌟[/b]
[list]
[*] Early Access to Beer Factory: Jump into the game and get a taste of the brewing life ahead of everyone else.
[*] Exclusive Playthrough of the First Part: Experience the initial stages of the game, where your journey as a brewmaster begins.
[*] Deep Dive into New Content: Explore in-depth the new features and mechanics we've lovingly crafted for you.
[*] Provide Valuable Feedback: Your insights on this early section are crucial. Share your thoughts and help us refine the final experience.
[*] Keep Your Progress 🔄
[*] All the progress you make during the playtest will be saved! You can transfer your save file to the full game, ensuring a smooth continuation of your brewing journey.
[/list]

[b]Joining the Playtest is Easy! 🎮[/b]
[olist]
[*] Head over to the Beer Factory Steam page.
[*] Click on "Request Access" for the playtest.
[/olist]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/1782570/Beer_Factory/][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385039/59dbfe4ed0bfcf363b4ccd270e5a8eff40f6ee25.png[/img][/url]

[list]
[*] Once you're in, download the game and start your brewing adventure!
[*] We're Listening 📢
[*] Your feedback is a key ingredient in our brewing process. As you play, let us know your experiences, ideas, and any bugs you encounter. Your input is invaluable in perfecting Beer Factory for its grand release.
[/list]

[b]Save the Date 📅[/b]
Remember, the full version of Beer Factory is brewing up for a release on [b]January 10th[/b]. Get ready for an immersive brewing experience!

[b]Stay in the Loop 🌐[/b]

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/cfg][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41385039/8c60d1d61e82e84b01f77d86f4fdb8b17cc9271a.png[/img][/url]

[b]Cheers to Your Brewing Adventure! 🎉[/b]
We're excited to see the breweries you create and the unique beers you brew. Thank you for joining us on this journey through the world of Beer Factory!

notes.title: Small update 30.03.2023
notes.content:
[b]New changes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Staying around the employee does not prevent him from working anymore, you have to look at him to make him stop
[*] The door of the fusebox close when the fuse is turned up
[*] Default steering speed 0.6 -> 0.75
[*] Added key mapping to the save system
[*] Improved the detection of the trucks and the pickup with Francis
[*] Forklift consume less
[/list]

[b]Bugs fixes:[/b]

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that made a pallet appear over and over again in front of the factory
[*] Fixed a bug that sometimes allowed to increase the speed of the conveyors to more than 20x the normal speed instead of the maximum of 2
[*] Fixed a bug that totally blocked the employee under certain conditions
[*] Fixed a bug that gave the animation to the employee that he has when he carries the garbage when he was assigned to a workstation
[*] Fixed a bug that gave access to a debug interface
[/list]

notes.title: Small update 21.03.2023
notes.content:
New change:

[list]
[*] The type of interaction between the objects in the hand and those in the environment has changed. For example, now the bags are not automatically placed on the pallets, they have to be dropped or thrown.
[/list]

Bugs fixes:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that triggered the call of the accountant when playing the Francis cinematic.
[*] Fixed a bug that made the coffee cup appear before making one.
[*] Fixed the fact that the orange pickup could be moved with the forklift.
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented to pass the level 3 objective if you had already passed the objective in advance.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed to block a trash bag in the corner of the dumpster.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed to throw objects outside the game zone.
[*] Fixed a bug that allowed to get static bags out of the pallets by placing the pallet on the running conveyors.
[/list]
